description: Generate, wrap, validate and build Bonita custom pages (React/Vue/Angular SPAs).

tools.name: scaffold_custom_page
tools.title: Scaffold a new Bonita custom page
tools.description: Create a NEW Bonita custom page project from a framework template. Use when the user wants to start from scratch with React, Vue or Angular.

name.description: Internal page name in camelCase. Becomes 'custompage_<name>' in page.properties and the ZIP filename.

displayName.description: Label shown in Bonita admin (e.g. 'Invoice Dashboard'). Defaults to name if omitted.

appToken.description: Bonita Application token. The page will be served at /bonita/apps/{appToken}/{pageToken}/.

pageToken.description: Page token within the application. Default: 'home'.

targetDir.description: Absolute path where the project should be created. Default: ./<name> in the current working directory.

tools.name: wrap_existing_app
tools.title: Wrap an existing SPA into a Bonita custom page
tools.description: Take an EXISTING React/Vue/Angular project and add the Bonita custom-page layer on top: page.properties, packaging script, multilingual deploy docs, build.sh/build.bat. Verifies critical configs (Vite base path, hash routing, withCredentials) and warns if anything looks off without modifying the user's app code.

framework.description: If omitted, detected from package.json / angular.json.

targetDir.description: Absolute path of the existing project to wrap.

tools.name: validate_custom_page_zip
tools.title: Validate a custom-page ZIP
tools.description: Open a ZIP and verify it has the layout Bonita requires: page.properties at root with valid name/contentType, resources/ directory, resources/index.html. Returns a JSON report. Use before uploading to catch packaging mistakes early.

zipPath.description: Absolute path to a page-*.zip file.

tools.name: build_custom_page
tools.title: Build a custom-page project
tools.description: Run npm install (if needed) and the project's build:bonita / dist script in the given directory. Returns the path to the produced ZIP and accompanying docs.

projectDir.description: Absolute path to a Bonita custom-page project (must have package.json and a build:bonita or dist script).

tools.name: get_deployment_guide
tools.title: Get the Bonita deployment guide
tools.description: Return the step-by-step deployment guide for a given Bonita version. Use when the user asks how to upload a custom page to Bonita.

version.description: Bonita version. Default: 2025.x (current). The 7.x guide uses the legacy Portal UI.

tools.name: list_custom_page_examples
tools.title: List bundled examples
tools.description: Return a list of the example projects shipped with the toolkit: React/Vue/Angular task viewers and directory-bonita variants. Useful for showing the user a ready-to-deploy starting point.
